title: Fastora ’25 — ignite the future of connectivity
excerpt: Telecom expert Eng. Anuradha Udunuwara on the fundamentals of 5G and its impact on modern industries.
content: Fastora ’25 – Ignite the Future of Connectivity was held at the Faculty of Engineering. Delivered by telecom expert Eng. Anuradha Udunuwara, the session explored the fundamentals of 5G technology and its impact on modern industries, concluding with an interactive Q&A.
